```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"output_format\":\"Djot\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Simple paragraph.</p>", options)
```
